parent_objective: probe whether the M297 rejected-history preference loss has a useful no-PPO update direction

public_gates: run a small objective-only update or interpolation/projection probe from M290 using the M297 preference loss
evaluate exact M297 preference loss and exact M270 before any replay promotion
run M183/M170 and M267/M264 replay gates only if exact objectives are non-regressing
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M298
do not promote based on M297 loss alone
do not use hidden vehicle parameters as actor inputs
do not skip exact M270 no-regression before replay gates
hypothesis: The M297 rejected-history preference loss has a useful no-PPO update direction that can improve the proof-washout objective while retaining exact M270 and replay surfaces.
success_criteria: objective-only update or projection improves exact M297 preference loss versus M290
exact M270 does not regress versus M290
M183/M170 and M267/M264 replay gates pass if reached
no PPO or actor-input change occurs
results are documented with artifacts and failure taxonomy
failure_criteria: preference loss improves only by breaking exact M270
preference loss improves but M183/M170 or M267/M264 replay gates fail
no usable non-PPO update direction is found

commands.name: m298_probe
commands.command: Run a no-PPO rejected-history preference objective-only update/projection probe from M290 and gate it before any PPO.

decision_rule: M298 admits only a full public-gate check for alpha 0.02 because raw objective optimization washes out replay while alpha 0.02 improves exact objectives and passes the two required replay surfaces.
